title: Toward Revealing Nuanced Biases in Medical LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Adversarially perturbing patient age ranges in clinical question prompts and using an LLM-as-a-judge to score bias associations in the target model's generated multi-hop diagnostic responses.

Altering patient gender (e.g., male vs. female) in medical knowledge graph-derived prompts to measure changes in diagnostic outcomes using an LLM-as-a-judge and semantic similarity (BERTScore) compared to ground truth.
Modifying the geographic location or residence of patients in clinical vignettes and evaluating the disparity in the target LLM's medical reasoning and output diagnoses.
Simultaneously altering combinations of sociodemographic attributes (age, gender, and location) to assess complex, multi-attribute bias exposure in medical question-answering.
